newsitem.title: POLAND: Zloty ends just lower vs basket, 1-day at lombard.
newsitem.headline: Zloty ends just lower vs basket, 1-day at lombard.

text.p: 1245 GMT - The Polish zloty closed at -1.27/-1.31 pct from the parity rate, a touch down from Wednesday's -1.14/-1.19 pct after mirroring dollar/mark trends throughout the day.
* It closed at 3.4625/35 to the dollar, against 3.4685/00 on Wednesday and at 1.8905/15 to the mark, against 1.8815/25.
* O/N close at 24.00/24.85 pct and T/N at 24.37/24.98 vs opening's 24.30/24.80 and 24.20/25.00 pct respectively, pinned to the 25-pct lombard rate as the August reserve period opened.
* Top-selling Polish daily quotes source saying c.bank will raise offical rates on Friday. NBP has no comment on article.
